Rich already supports orange text. Use a named colour such as `orange1`, `orange3`, `dark_orange` or `orange_red1` in markup, for example `[orange1]Hello[/]`, or pass `style="orange1"` to `Console.print`. The full list of colour names is in the colour table at https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst and the markup syntax is on https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst

If you need a colour that is not in the list, `Color.parse` accepts hex values such as `#ff8700`.

For questions about how to use Rich, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place. Feature requests need approval there first.
